patch.value: GH-719: reject or diagnose extension command flags shadowed by pm globals

Extension command definitions can register flags such as --json whose help text appears extension-owned even though Commander routes the value only to pm global options. Add registration-time validation or an explicit bounded diagnostic, make help truthful, document reserved global names and context.global access, and cover real activation plus invocation instead of API doubles.

Registration rejects or explicitly warns for every extension flag colliding with a canonical or aliased pm global flag; Help and runtime routing cannot imply the value reaches context.options when it is global-only; SDK authoring docs and scaffold guidance expose reserved flags and context.global access; Real installed-extension tests cover activation, help, and invocation at full repository quality gates
